title: Fox White Technologies
description: Automatic blocks for Botania. New levels of pool, spreaders and sparks
body: # **FoxWhiteTechnologies** *** ## This mod is designed for GTNH version of mods! **Fox White Technologies** is a tech-focused addon for Botania that brings automation, upgrades, and a whole new level of efficiency to your mana systems 🌿⚡ > Turn your magical setup into a fully automated technological masterpiece. ## ⚡ What does this mod add? 🌿 **Advanced Botania automation** Automate processes that usually require manual interaction — less clicking, more progress. ⚙️ **New tiers of mana infrastructure** Enhanced pools, spreaders, and sparks that push your system beyond vanilla limits. 🔄 **Smart automatic blocks** Let your base run itself while you focus on expansion and creativity. ## 😏 Why use it? ✔️ Because Botania can be smarter ✔️ Because automation = efficiency ✔️ Because you’re tired of doing everything manually ✔️ Because magic + tech = perfection ## 🧪 Who is this mod for? * 🌿 Botania lovers * 🏭 Automation fans * 🔧 Tech modpack creators * 😈 Players who want MORE power ## ⚠️ Requirements * Minecraft **1.7.10 (Forge)** * **Botania** GTNH Version  ## 🌐 Join the Community 💬 Got questions? Ideas? Found a bug? Join our Discord and be part of the project! 👉 **Discord:** **[\-2 Circle of Hell](https://discord.gg/Td59WbfApr)**
